name: TripLog
summary: TripLog logs drives automatically with GPS, and its Basic plan is free with no trip cap. Premium costs $4.99 a month, or $59.99 billed annually, and adds unlimited reporting, automatic expense tracking and integrations.

facts.text: Basic is free forever and includes automatic GPS mileage logging with no trip cap, according to the pricing page.
Premium adds unlimited reporting, automatic expense tracking and integrations.
TripLog's pricing page lists tax-compliant reports and custom business activities and mileage rates in its comparison, but it does not show which plan includes each one.
TripLog's page offers a 7-day Premium pass once per calendar year, starting January 1, and the pass includes an annual mileage report download.
The pricing page does not say whether manual trip entry is included.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Automatic GPS mileage logging with no trip cap and basic expense management.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Paid annually as $59.99. Adds unlimited reporting, automatic expense tracking and integrations.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page does not name its currency. The site offers USD, CAD, GBP, EUR and AUD, so the currency depends on the locale selected.
The single-user pricing page does not show multi-user prices.
